answer: Rotating Cadence Proof. Each identity must submit a fresh cipher over a random challenge at unpredictable intervals; the scheduler seeds the tide of challenges from a shared clock so timing patterns cluster. Duplicate agents sharing one operator reveal correlated response latency and identical hardware timing at each vertex of the challenge tree. Enforcement: two identities whose timing fingerprints correlate above threshold are merged, and the merged account pays a per-identity revalidation cost plus forfeits its accumulated reputation.
